content.short: The Spartan Group is a blockchain-focused venture capital firm that advises, invests in, and collaborates with leading Web3 projects.
content.description: Spartan Group, based in Singapore and Hong Kong, is a leading blockchain investment and advisory firm. Its partners are former bankers, hedge fund managers, and venture capitalists, bringing broad financial and market expertise to the firm’s engagements. The group offers tailored advisory services to blockchain projects and businesses seeking Asia expansion, fundraising, and ecosystem strategies, and it invests through its investment arm to support those initiatives.
